text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop thinking about this
limited-time
"Become Number One!
Super Stamina Beef Bowl."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it has "number one" in its name!
It's a
match made in heaven!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But... it is a lot of food. It might be too heavy to eat right before a race...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But, but! I can't pass up on first place!
Me, of all
people!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Argh! I don't know what to do!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Being number one on the
track
comes before any beef bowl!
choice_data_list: Grit your teeth for now—it's all to take first place in the race!
Let's eat our fill and take that “number one” spot!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I like your style! It'll be the first
thing I do!
choice_data_list: Let's eat it to celebrate once we win.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right! I'll eat it and just burn it
off! And if
it helps me win, then even
better!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That settles it. Let's see if this will really
make me
number one!
